content: If the liquid contains particles or discoloration, do not use it. Before administering each dose, clean the injection site on the skin with rubbing alcohol. Rotate the injection site with each administration to minimize the risk of skin injury. To reduce bruising, avoid rubbing the injection site after the injection. Use this medication exactly as prescribed by your doctor to achieve the maximum benefit. Common side effects may include redness or pain at the injection site, headache, mild nausea, stomach pain, or fatigue. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. However, this medication may cause a condition called ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS), which can occur during or after treatment. In rare cases, severe OHSS can lead to sudden fluid accumulation in the abdomen, chest, and heart area. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. This is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Before using ganirelix, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other products containing gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients (such as latex) that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. This treatment may result in multiple births. Discontinue use of this medication if you become pregnant, as it must not be used during pregnancy. It is unknown if this drug passes into breast milk. Due to potential risks to the infant, breastfeeding is not recommended while using this medication. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if someone exhibits serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (such as vaginal ultrasound, hormone levels, liver tests) may be conducted. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist immediately for a new dosing schedule. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
